statement: The Committee cut the policy rate to 1.25% as inflation remains well below 2% and slack persists, to support a sustained return to target.
rationale: Inflation at 0.96% is ~1pp below 2% target and still falling (1.17%->0.96%), output gap at -0.72% remains negative despite recent improvement. Real rate (1.5-0.96=0.54%) is below neutral 1.0% but tightening in real terms as inflation falls, and slack continues to drag on inflation. Taylor rule implies 1.25%. Markets stable (Q7 return +518bps, drawdown 0.17%, no halts/margin calls), so no financial stability constraint on easing. A 25bp cut provides additional accommodation to close output gap and return inflation to target over medium term with lags, while preserving gradualism.
